notes.title: Infinity Heroes Open Beta Free Release & Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to the Infinity Heroes Open Beta release!
[/h2]
From today, Infinity Heroes is completely free to access directly through Steam. Not only that, but we'll be having a period of complete access to all existing heroes for beta testing purposes before we activate the owned hero requirement and free hero rotation, so it's a great time to get into the game and play with any heroes you desire, so you know which you're likely to choose to unlock first!

The game's full release and mobile releases are still under works, however we'll be focusing on Infinity Wars Classic in preparation for it's upcoming launch. If you want to see our progress on IWC you can check out the newest patch notes [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/257730/view/3349004388904627727]clicking here[/url].

We have a small patch included with this, so let's look at some patch notes.

[h2]New IH Hero - Theseus[/h2]

Theseus, the Cruel Cleanser, is the newest to Infinity Heroes. Disrupt the enemy with Theseus and his mix of DoD and Verore magic. Play defensive early game then watch as multiple aggressive bonuses unlock when your max resources reaches 10. But don't burn yourself out!

[h2]New Feature - Turn Unlocking[/h2]

We now have turn unlocking for multiplayer battles!
Once you lock in your turn, you can now unlock the turn you submitted to make other additional moves. When waiting for the opponent to make their turn, we also have new display behaviour which includes the unlock button, and the environment lighting transitions to night time. You can now also properly interact with the cards on the board and other user interface panels.
Note: If you go to unlock your turn at the same time the opponent submits their turn, your unlock action may not happen as it must be approved by the opponent due to client networking speeds and delays.

[h2]New Content - Adventure Mode Updates[/h2]

Additional relics and unlockable cards have been implimented for Adventure mode, as well as improvements to various late game boss battles. In addition, you can now properly complete a full 9 mission adventure mode run, no longer bugging out at the end. Also improved Adventure mode user interface and saving. Please note this might wipe old adventure save files for runs that were mid-run.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in the 2nd Tutorial that could cause dialogue to play out of order
[*] Fixed Adventure mode freezing if the game is a draw
[*] Fixed One of Many having incorrect artwork
[*] Fixed One of Many having incorrect costs on its transform
[*] Fixed missing tags causing some cards to not appear in adventure mode pools
[*] Fixed errors sometimes appearing for players who don't have discord open
[*] Fixed spell Relic functionality
[*] Fixed Relics with missing artwork
[*] Fixed healing relics not working correctly in Adventure mode if the opponent has a flame of fate relic
[*] Fixed Pacifying Winds not correctly killing cards moved to the attack zone by other effects
[*] Fixed Phalanx commander's targetting
[*] Fixed Subjugated Dragon's death trigger
[*] Fixed Sydern's resource ability's interaction with certain relics
[*] Fixed various internal testing cards appearing in Adventure mode pools
[*] Fixed multiple broken spritesheets
[*] Fixed typos on multiple cards
[*] Fixed turn timers not correctly updating
[*] Fixed Character cards that are exhausted being permanently exhusted visually when moved to hand
[*] Fixed Wish cards working with discounted costs
[/list]

Thanks for all of your support. If you like the game, feel free to leave a positive review! Our steam rating is still sitting on Mixed due to some early bugs and misconceptions due to people thinking it was Infinity Wars 2, and we aim to correct that over time, as the game has much more content, is much more stable, and now free. 

Or, if you think there's something you'd like to see us work on and fix for Infinity Heroes, feel free to let us know in the Steam Comments, we'd love your feedback.

See you on the Battlefield, Rift Runner!

notes.title: Infinity Heroes content update: Two new IH Heroes
notes.content:
Greetings, Rift Runners. We haven't published a full patch recently with our focus being on engine/IWC stuff, so here's a double whammy, with two new heroes!

[h2]Cathleen
[/h2]
Cathleen, a powerful aggressive value-driven character, who has a flexible array of tools for beast and men alike.
Their hero power is Reinforcements. Put a copy of a target friendly unit on the top of your deck, and it gains Charge next turn.

[h3]Units[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Tracks the Cowardly[/b], your early-game unit, which buffs a random unit in your hand on death but only for a single turn.
[*] [b]Terror Moose[/b], A charge unit that moves a target unit to the defense zone when played,
[*] [b]Haunted Elkmare[/b], your beefier base unit with Untouchable, for avoiding opponent's effects
[*] [b]Umbral Warden[/b], A heavy striker with Charge and Bloodthirst
[/list]

[h3]Spells
[/h3][list]
[*] [b]Cleanse Impurities[/b], A spell that can either buff your own units, or damage opponents units, with upgrade potential. Very versatile.
[*] [b]Shamba's Unity[/b], buff a friendly unit, and it gains Untouchable.
[/list]

[h3]Ultimates
[/h3][list]
[*] [b]Shamba, Reborn[/b], A beast which grants a permanent stat buff to your allies as long as they remain in the assault or defense zones.
[*] [b]Memorial to Heroes[/b], which creates a copy of each unit you control, as well as all buffs and debuffs.
[/list]

[h2]Vis, the Furious
[/h2]
The only important point of health is your last, damage yourself and your opponent and live life on the edge.
Their hero power is Reckless Rampage, dealing 1 damage to themselves and their opponent.

[h3]Units[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Vicious Ransacker[/b], a unit which gets stronger whenever you take damage.
[*] [b]Reckless Zealot[/b], cheap and charge based, but also gains double it's stats for the turn if you are again below 5 health.
[*] [b]Noble Protector[/b], which harms your hero to deal damage to another unit when played
[*] [b]Decimator[/b], the beefy boy that damages ALL units and heroes whenever it attacks.
[/list]

[h3]Spells
[/h3][list]
[*] [b]Power of the Underdog[/b], A damage spell that turns into a kill spell below 5 health.
[*] [b]Intimidating Rally[/b], Moves a target defending unit to the support zone.
[/list]

[h3]Ultimates
[/h3][list]
[*] [b]Klore, Rapier Centurion[/b], A low-cost high-health unit, who only takes a max of 1 damage from all sources if you're below 5 total health.
[*] [b]Fiery Wish[/b], which gives every single card you draw Charge, for the rest of the game.
[/list]



If you're interested in the full Infinity Wars Classic patch notes, you can find those [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/257730/view/3108047857109672307]HERE[/url]. Alternatively, we hope you enjoy the new content.

notes.title: Infinity Heroes content update: Pras, the Traitor
notes.content:
Greetings, Rift Runners. It's been quite some time, but here's the newest hero to feature in Infinity Heroes!

[h2]Pras, the Traitor
[/h2]
Pras, the Traitor is a Cultist and Flame Dawn mixed deck that is aggressive and is able to manipulate the battlefield. 
Their hero power is [b]Revenge[/b], which targets a unit that dealt damage to them last turn, and kills it.

[h3]Units[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Ghost Knight[/b], a low cost unit with Resist.
[*] [b]Black Bind Witch[/b], that helps buff another unit as long as it's on the field.
[*] [b]Demon of Fear[/b], which can be upgraded for a heavy cost to stop your opponent from blocking a turn.
[*] [b]Decimator[/b], a Multi-Strike unit with Trample.
[*] 
[/list]
[h3]Spells
[/h3][list]
[*] [b]Ferocity[/b], giving a unit an attack buff and moving it to the assault zone.
[*] [b]Void Split[/b], that kills an enemy unit, and buffs two random friendly units based on the killed unit's stats.
[/list]

[h3]Ultimates
[/h3][list]
[*] [b]Subjugated Dragon[/b], a defending flying dragon that turns into demons upon death.
[*] [b]Ablaze[/b], which immolates your opponent, doing damage over time to them.
[/list]

Pras is the 20th hero to be released, and we're looking forward to seeing how he fares.

Also worth mentioning, is we have a new bug reporter menu that we've been actively using for the Infinity Wars Classic pre-Alpha, and it functions in Infinity Heroes as well! So, if you run into anything pesky or broken, we can start fixing IH based bugs with a lot faster results now hopefully!



Our focus recently has been on the Infinity Card Engine, as well as IWC, however now that we're approaching a comfortable level on these, we're going to be giving some love to IH in the coming weeks as we prepare for an eventual open-beta launch, hitting free to play in the Steam Store and hopefully bringing in more players for everyone to go against!

notes.title: Dev Diary: Patch 0.9.03.B "Adventure Expanded" & Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]PATCH NOTES
[/h1]

[h2]MAJOR FEATURE: New Menu System[/h2]
The menu has undergone a significant improvements to better make use of the space available on PC, this should better allow you to look at your roguelike decks, view the content of heroes and much more.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37038999/8ee11f9cb617c01ef9b53699ed9e34bf9c71b77f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37038999/3d8426bc4da58dd874fd4f62e01eddc33981b2e1.png[/img][/url]

[h2]MAJOR FEATURE: IW2 New Roguelike Content[/h2]
Many improvements and updates to the roguelike gamemode have been made, including tuning to various AI decks, and cards that can appear both in enemy AI decks and the card pools that are from our prototype IW2 game.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37038999/dd7038bdd8ae5f93de223ede08792f97d9dc596a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37038999/871c22a24d3920429cc1e49eb7bd080f31204d49.png[/img][/url]

[h2]MAJOR FEATURE: Quests[/h2]
Your account is now granted various objectives every 24 hours, to a maximum of 3 quests at any one time. Completing these will grant currency that you will soon be able to use to purchase cosmetics and other items in the future. We currently have 6 quests and will be expanding this number soon.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37038999/c2184a7b40ea2acb0cfe82c51256140f93a68432.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37038999/d936497a1e540ad5ef937fef45a9e0bef0b30f77.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Other features[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Global Relics
[*] New Battlefields
[*] Improve the asset bundles to improve loading times
[*] New cursor
[*] New Infinity engine logo
[*] Ingame Deck display now allows zooming
[*] Improved visuals of roguelike choice panels
[/list]

[h2]BUG FIXES [/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed old save files causing corruption
[*] Fixed rest stop duplication error
[*] Fixed crash at the final level of roguelike mode
[*] Fixed asset bundles breaking with custom heroes
[*] Fixed attack triggers not working in specific situations
[/list]

In our latest patch “Adventure Expanded”, Our results for the Infinity Card Engine are starting to really ramp up, and that means new stuff to show off in Infinity Heroes, including our new overhauled Menu system! It’s so much more interactive, and feels like an amazing improvement. We also have more cards in Adventure mode thanks to our efforts on the Infinity Wars 2 Prototype. Speaking of, in the coming days we are going to be turning off the ability to grab access to the Infinity Wars 2 Prototype, as we don’t want too many people to be witnessing the first playable versions of the game.

We’ll also have more to share regarding Infinity Wars Classic in the coming weeks, so our oldest fans should stay tuned for more.

Additionally, with the UI improvements, there’s now a lot more functionality that’s been added to the Adventure Mode, which pairs in amazingly with the new cards that have also been added in to give more variety and spice to your deckbuilding potential. Additionally, the ability to view your deck as a whole while building it adds a great deal of clarity to the entire mode. Now you know exactly what you do, and will have as you head into the upcoming rounds.

And as always, we’d love to hear from everyone on Discord, where we’ve been hosting Dev Team streams, where our players can come and chat, challenge us to a game, and ask us whatever’s on their mind across any of our games. If you’re not already there, check the link out and we’ll meet you there!

Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/dTWAE8x]discord.gg/dTWAE8x[/url]

~Reuben Covington & Jason Thomas

notes.title: Infinity Heroes 0.9.01c Patch notes
notes.content:
Welcome to patch 0.9.01c!

A bunch of these changes have been seen in the quiet 0.8 launch we had around a month ago, and now we've further improved on those changes and additional content.


[h1]MAJOR FEATURE: New VFX System
[/h1]In continued efforts to modernize the visuals of the game we have reworked the visual particle effects systems for cards, card abilities and background animations, adding dozens of new visual spectacles as well as play animations for many cards.

[h1]MAJOR FEATURE: New Roguelike Content
[/h1]Many improvements and updates to the roguelike gamemode have been made, including tuning to various AI decks, new roguelike only neutral cards and relics, and new challenges to fight.
Finally we have a save system that allows you to save a custom hero image.

[h1]MINOR ADDITIONS / CHANGES
[/h1][list]
[*] New Flying visual battlefield effect, with plans for more onfield animations for keywords
[*] Improvements to the upgrade system for future use with non-unit cards
[*] New Global Relics
[*] New Battlefields
[*] Improvements to the xp and account systems
[*] Hero card now always animate
[*] A number of exciting new systems we will be making available soon
[/list]
[h1]BUG FIXES [/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed stability issues with roguelike mode after 3 rounds
[*] Fixed Tome of Health triggering multiple times a game in some situations
[*] Fixed an end of game loop that gave infinite xp and losses
[*] Fixed various broken animations
[*] Fixed issues with the main menu scroll buttons
[*] Fixed various textbox issues
[*] Fixed various battlefield alignment issues
[*] Fixed roguelike hero customisations bugs
[*] And many more minor fixes
[/list]

A lot of our work has been going towards the IW2 prototype, and you'll likely be seeing some new updates on that hopefully in the coming weeks. Until then, jump into a few games of IH and enjoy the new visual upgrades and adventure mode!

notes.title: Infinity Heroes 0.7.3 Patch notes
notes.content:
Welcome to patch 0.7.3, soon after 0.7.1 went live we had some additional features that were pretty well behaved, and now you get to experience them yourself!

[h2]MAJOR FEATURES:[/h2]
[list][*] Added Custom Hero Mode for Adventure Mode ( more at the bottom )
[/list]

[list][*] Fixed an incorrect art for Lyco Wolf being displaying in roguelike mode

https://discord.gg/dTWAE8x

~JasonOCE
Community Coordinator, Lightmare.

notes.title: Infinity Heroes 0.6.2 Patch notes
notes.content:
Welcome to patch update for 0.6.2 ( and 0.6.1 )

We’ve been hard at work fixing up a lot of the core functionality of the game, and also working on the in-app store for later use. Here’s the big patch notes for both 0.6.2 and our previous 0.6.1 that released quietly in between, as well as some hotfixes we threw in there in-between.

[h1]0.6.2 PATCH NOTES[/h1]


[b]MAJOR FEATURE:[/b] Infinity Heroes Store
Infinity Heroes now contains a limited store page ingame for access to in-app purchases. On PC linking your Infinity Heroes account to your steam account will be required. We will be expanding this store over the next few weeks as we add purchasable backgrounds, new heroes and other items. Purchases will be made using the Steam Wallet but all items purchased will be cross-platform.
[b]MAJOR FEATURE:[/b] Infinity Wars 2 Preorder
Purchasable in the store now! Infinity Wars 2's Pre-Alpha Prototype Preorder gives you:
- Access to Infinity Wars 2 ( Available via IW2's Steam page, Soon™ )
- Access to the pre-alpha Infinity Wars 2 Prototype build of the game within Infinity Heroes ( Available in IH 0.8 ) 
- Lava Battleground (timed exclusive) in both Infinity Heroes and IW2 ( Available in IH 0.7 )

Unlike the separate release, the IW2 Prototype gives you full access to a playset of every single card from Infinity Wars 1 as they are coded in. This product is for experienced Infinity Wars players who wish to give early feedback on the game directly to the developers, and those Infinity Heroes players who are ready for something more complex and challenging, by being able to eventually deckbuild with the entire Infinity Wars 1 collection of cards.

For more information see our website

- Added steam account linking UI for accessing the store 
- New global relic for this week's rotation: Flame of Fate. 
- Added road map and patch notes popup display to show current project progress. 
- Fixed some bugs when repeatedly logging in and logging back out
- Removed automatic scrolling of the menu backgrounds

BUG FIXES 
- Fixed functionality for some of the upgrade cards for the Pay extra system
- Fixed layering of objects when zooming into a card in your hand
- Fixed some playfab bugs caused by having a slow internet connection
- Fixed some text elements that were not connected to the localisation system

[h1]0.6.1 PATCH NOTES[/h1]

PATCH NOTES 
- Added account name displays for the in-game matchup panel 
- Twisted Rune Relic now only modifies within a range
- Created save system for adventure mode. Players can play other modes and come back to their adventure game later. Doesn't currently save if application closes)
- Added card upgrade system for spending additional mana to upgrade a card
- Added account usernames to end of match result panel
- Added a password recovery feature to the login panel.
- Rotated available relics
- Added backend from customizable backgrounds
- Added more steamwork backend connections
- Added new main menu backgrounds

BUG FIXES 
- Fixed the card tooltip displays for zoomed cards in the hero skill panel
- Fixed adventure mode bugs and added reset run button 
- Fixed battlefield card border for created token cards 
- Fixed overlapping of battlefield and hand cards 
- Added changeable background image system for main menu 
- Fixed bug with opponent moving battlefield cards pre-maturely
- Fixed Manaburn causing desyncs
- Fixed Manaburn not applying to the game-over screen
- Fixed Dragon Tamer having a broken card-definition prefab
- Fixed Aerial Commander granting enemies flying when upgraded
- Fixed the final few levels of the roguelike mode causing crashes
- Fixed incorrect ability text on Rita’s hero power
- Fixed Dragon Mother’s attack ability not triggering correctly
- Fixed some attack abilities freezing the game if the blocking unit is killed by the ability before a combat round.
- Fixed Archive Fanatic textbox
- Fixed Airborne Scientist not being able to upgrade
- Fixed Upgraded unit’s not calculating their costs correctly
- Fixed issues where the player would be kicked from the game during the game-over screen


As you might see, there’s also a pre-order button for the new Infinity Wars 2 prototype. This is ONLY for our veteran players, and you can read more about it at our separate blog post over here:

https://steamcommunity.com/games/257730/partnerevents/view/2082293429504287271

Hopefully you’re enjoying Infinity Heroes, feel free to tune in to us on Discord and say hi to the Dev team, we’d love to hear from you.

https://discord.gg/dTWAE8x

See you on the battlefield!

~JasonOCE
Community Coordinator, Lightmare.
